Marco (Eng Manager): Quick q — we merged two squads and want to do an off-cycle promo for one IC. Is there a separate flow vs regular cycle?
Leah (People Ops): Short answer: same core flow but with a few extra checks for off-cycle (capacity review + payroll cutoff).
Marco (Eng Manager): Got it. The person is international (UK). Any different paperwork?
Leah (People Ops): Yes — for UK you need local comp approval + immigration check if visa-related. Also PRORATION rules apply for gross pay adjustments.
Marco (Eng Manager): Proration — is that automatic? I want to know backpay possibility.
Jia (Comp Lead): Proration happens on the effective date for salary changes. Backpay can be requested for retro start dates up to 90 days, but approvals are stricter for off-cycle. Provide evidence and business rationale.
Marco (Eng Manager): Evidence = promo writeup + impact examples?
Leah (People Ops): Exactly. Please include: role scope before/after, 3 concrete examples of impact, any manager calibration notes, and peer feedback if available.
Emma (People Ops): Helpful checklist (you can copy into the promo form):
```
- Manager justification (200-400 words)
- Before/after role summary
- 3 impact bullet points with dates
- Peer/IC feedback (1-2 lines)
- Proposed comp (base, currency, equity ask)
- Effective date and requested backpay window
```
Marco (Eng Manager): Thanks — where do I submit?
Leah (People Ops): Use the promo submission form: https://go.redwood.com/promo-form. Pick "Off-cycle" and attach the evidence doc.
Marco (Eng Manager): Payroll cutoff — what's safe?
Samir (Payroll): If you want the change in the next payroll run, submit approvals at least 7 business days before cutoff. For retro pay we need final approval + comp signoff before payroll closes.
Marco (Eng Manager): If the effective date is the day they moved teams (2 weeks ago), do I put that date?
Jia (Comp Lead): Put the actual requested effective date and note the reason for retro. We'll route to comp and payroll for review.
Marco (Eng Manager): Any limits on equity refresh off-cycle?
Leah (People Ops): Off-cycle equity refreshes require Director-level approval and must fit within band guidelines. Include a proposed grant amount and justification.
Marco (Eng Manager): Sounds reasonable. One edge case: this person was on an IC-level cap in old squad but new role has higher band. Any special steps?
Jia (Comp Lead): If moving bands, we do a band uplift review. That needs comp team + your skip-level signoff. We check internal equity before approving upward band moves.
Marco (Eng Manager): Cool. One more: contractor -> perm status + promo at once. Pay implications?
Leah (People Ops): Contractors converting to employees is a different process (hire packet + offer letter). If you want promo on conversion, note it in the offer and comp will evaluate. Payroll will not retro base for contractor earnings.
Marco (Eng Manager): Good to know.
payroll-bot: Reminder: next UK payroll cutoff is 2071234590 (UTC). Submissions after cutoff will be processed next cycle.
Samir (Payroll): If you need help double-checking dates before submit, drop me the proposed effective date and I’ll confirm cutoff risk.
Marco (Eng Manager): Will do — thanks everyone. I'll draft the evidence doc and ping Emma for a quick review before submitting.
Emma (People Ops): Happy to review — send the draft here or DM. :thumbsup:
Leah (People Ops): FYI — if this escalates to exception (over-band comp), allow 3-5 business days for comp committee review.
Marco (Eng Manager): Understood. Appreciate the quick answers.
Emma (People Ops): Closing note: attach salary history only if requested by comp team; don't include personal bank/payroll screenshots.
Marco (Eng Manager): Noted. Thanks!
